title: Is it possible to do a BUU's Fury like game with RPG Maker MV/ MZ ?

posts.author: Prime90034
posts.body:
So I've been thinking about this a lot lately. But I'd truly want to believe with RPG Maker we could push it to make a game that plays like Buu's Fury. Does anyone else thing this is possible? I use MV, but would it be possible with either MV/MZ?
I'd love to hear takes, see potential help on this etc. Not sure where I'd start!

posts.author: Erif
posts.body:
I hope it doesn't come as aggressive but you might wanna give more details, not all people have played Buu's fury.
If you're referring to the movement, MV already has mostly it. If you're referring to combat, an ABS (Action Battle System) might be your best ally.

posts.author: AquaEcho
posts.body: I looked up a video and skimmed to the gameplay and it looks like your typical ABS. You could do it in Chrono Engine or another ABS like the official MZ one or Alpha ABS.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
As with all questions - the code for the game's engine is in your js folder. Anything "is possible" - the more helpful question is how hard it is, and how much time, effort, and coding knowledge would be required.
And, of course, as pointed out - I don't know about most, but certainly many people (including me) have never heard of the game you're talking about - when you're talking about Dragonball games on the Gameboy Advance, that's a pretty niche audience.
So it would make much more sense to ask about specific features or gameplay that you're trying to emulate.
